Name: Clube Albufeira Garden Village
Company description: Luxuoso empreendimento que proporciona aos visitantes, agradáveis momentos de lazer, num ambiente cuidado e cativante, onde podem escolher entre quatro soberbos conjuntos de piscinas. Nos Restaurantes "O Pavilhão" e "A Casa Azul", poderá deliciar-se com a típica comida portuguesa e internacional, ou refrescar-se com um cocktail exótico servido nos bares das piscinas. A nossa equipa estará sempre ao seu dispôr para lhe proporcionar umas férias inesquecíveis O Clube Albufeira Garden Village  está situado a 35 Km do Aeroporto Internacional de Faro, menos de 30 minutos de automóvel. Localizado na estrada de Ferreiras para Albufeira, tem um fácil acesso ao centro da cidade, bem como à E.N. 125 e á Via do Infante. Esta última é uma via rápida com ligação directa à vizinha Espanha. É composto por mais de 350 moradias e apartamentos, mobilados com requinte e equipados de modo a tornar a sua estadia ainda mais agradável.

Name: Penha Longa Resort
Company description: Penha Longa Resort, part of The Ritz-Carlton portfolio, is a luxurious destination located in the breathtaking Sintra mountains of Portugal. This exquisite resort offers a harmonious blend of opulence and natural beauty, featuring a world-class golf course, a lavish spa, and exceptional dining options that cater to discerning travelers seeking both relaxation and adventure. With a mission to provide exceptional service and create unforgettable experiences, Penha Longa Resort aims to leave a lasting impression on its guests, whether they are enjoying a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or a corporate retreat. The resort attracts a diverse clientele, including leisure travelers, golf enthusiasts, and business groups, and partners with local artisans and culinary experts to enhance its offerings. Its vision is to be a premier destination that harmonizes luxury with the stunning landscapes of Portugal, ensuring that every guest departs with a sense of rejuvenation and inspiration. Nestled within its expansive grounds is a historic 14th-century monastery, seamlessly blending history with modern luxury. Penha Longa Resort features 204 newly renovated rooms and suites, all designed to provide comfort and stunning views of the surrounding natural park and golf course. The resort is home to two Michelin-starred restaurants, LAB by Sergi Arola and Midori, which showcase innovative culinary artistry. Catering to families, couples, and golf enthusiasts, the resort offers a renowned 27-hole championship golf course and a variety of family-friendly activities, including a dedicated kids' program. Committed to wellness, the Penha Longa SPA and Wellness Club provides personalized treatments and exclusive facilities, enhancing relaxation and rejuvenation. The resort also serves as an ideal venue for meetings, events, and weddings, thanks to its stunning setting and versatile spaces. With a dedication to sustainability, Penha Longa Resort implements eco-friendly practices and is recognized as a Green Key Resort, contributing positively to the local ecosystem. By partnering with local attractions in Sintra and Cascais, the resort serves as a perfect base for exploring the rich cultural and natural beauty of the region, ensuring that every guest's experience is both memorable and enriching.

Name: Amendoeira Golf Resort
Company description: Amendoeira Golf Resort is a premier destination in the Algarve, offering a diverse range of services and experiences designed to enhance guests' stays. The resort's mission is to provide memorable experiences, whether through exploring stunning natural landscapes, indulging in relaxing treatments, or participating in high-quality golf lessons. Catering to a wide clientele, including families, adventure seekers, and relaxation enthusiasts, Amendoeira Golf Resort serves as an ideal base for discovering the rich cultural and historical offerings of the region. With amenities such as a dedicated children's club and professional golf instruction, the resort aims to create a welcoming environment for guests of all ages. Additionally, the resort partners with local attractions and cultural events to ensure visitors can fully immerse themselves in the vibrant lifestyle of the Algarve.

Name: Boavista Golf & Spa Resort
Company description: Boavista Golf Resort opened in January 2002 and quickly became established as one of the Western Algarve’s premier resorts. With an exceptional 18-hole championship course it is one of the Algarve’s most beautifully manicured courses, bordered by properties all designed to harmonize with the land’s natural contours.  A golf academy with outstanding practice facilities which include a driving range and a short game practice area is available and to keep players well fitted we have our friendly golf shop with all the latest fashion trends and golf equipment. Cosy resort villages offer an exciting mix of luxury properties with sea and golf views, and attractive outdoor pools which create a residential oasis where the delights of the Algarvian lifestyle can be enjoyed by its owners and guests alike.  The onsite Essential and Fitness Spa is second to none in the Western Algarve and offers a superb range of beauty treatments. In addition to the heated indoor pool overlooking the bay of Lagos and Monchique hills you’ll find a well-equipped gym, Jacuzzi, steam bath and sauna. We have floodlit tennis courts and a football pitch as well as safe children’s play area. The latest addition to the resort is the games centre next to the Spa offering archery, voleyball, croquet and petanque where guests and members can have fun with family and friends. There are always activities taking place at the resort to suit all tastes such as Zumba, Pilates, aqua-aerobics, bridge club and walking trips to name a few. The family friendly clubhouse restaurant|bar and lounge area is a comfortable and cosy place to eat breakfast, lunch and dinner. Enjoy our large sunny terrace with some of the finest views of the bay of Lagos and watch golfers finishing their round on the 18th green. Events such as wine evenings and summer BBQ’s are always being planned and don’t miss out on our popular traditional Sunday Carvery.

Name: Golden Club Cabanas
HQ Location: Portugal, Faro, De Tavira, Rua Tuberária Major Cabanas, 8800-591
Company description: Golden Club Cabanas is located on the waterfront, at the heart of the Nature Reserve of Ria Formosa, with magnificent views of the lagoon, close to the historic town of Tavira and to six golf courses, and 40 km away from the international airport of Faro. The resort provides three swimming pools, sauna, Turkish baths, Jacuzzi, exercise room, beach volleyball and multisport courts, boat to the beach, restaurant, bars, Children’s Club, sports and evening entertainment, and a low-rise aparthotel. Enjoy the comfort of low-rise holiday apartments with hotel service, in a protected area, facing a secluded sandy white beach. For more information, please visit our website: http://www.goldenclubcabanas.com/en/

Name: RR Hotels
Company description: Fell at home!  O Grupo RR Hotels fundado em 1992, tem no seu universo de investimentos, interesses em diversas áreas, como a Hotelaria, Imobiliária, Catering e Eventos.  Presentemente, o Grupo está focado na área da exploração e gestão turística e opera em Portugal, depois de experiências de sucesso em Angola e Marrocos, tendo no seu portfolio o HOTEL DA ROCHA Suite Hotel (4*), o ALVOR BAÍA Resort Hotel (4*) e o CLUB AMARILIS Apartamentos Turísticos (3*). The RR Hotels Group was founded in 1992, has in its universe of investments, interests in diverse areas such as Hospitality, Real Estate, Catering and Events.  At present, the Group is focused in the area of exploration and tourism management and operates in Portugal, after successful experiences in Angola and Morocco, having at the presente time in its portfolio the HOTEL DA ROCHA Suite Hotel , the ALVOR BAÍA Resort Hotel (4*) and CLUB AMARILIS Apartamentos Turísticos (3 *).

Name: Four Seasons Country Club | Resort
HQ Location: Portugal, Almancil, Avenida André Jordan Quinta Do Lago, 8135-024
Company description: The club, established in 1986, enjoys a privileged location, nestling within the pinewoods and golfing greens of Quinta do Lago which is renown as Europe's most upmarket residencial and leisure resort. The 1800-acres of the Quinta do Lago estate is partly embraced by the Ria Formosa Natural Park, a protected nature reserve of the world importance. Four Seasons Country Club is the perfect base to enjoy the secluded tranquility of Quinta do Lago in relaxed style or, on the other hand, indulge in more active pursuits through a comprehensive range of sports and leisure activities. Apart from guaranteed golf times at a reduced green fee to members of the Four Seasons Country Club on two local courses, there is much to do for all ages - Cycling, horse-riding, lawn bowls, windsurfing and sailing on the lake, swimming, snorkelling and scuba diving.

Name: Monte Rei Golf & Country Club
Company description: Welcome to one of the most exclusive developments of its kind - featuring two unique, championship Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Courses, set in over 1,000 acres of glorious countryside in Portugal’s Eastern Algarve.  Located in the unspoilt countryside between the dramatic Serra do Caldeirão mountains and the Atlantic Ocean, the landscaping has been carefully designed to ensure that the Algarvean lanscape is preserved and enhanced. With a building density that is one of the lowest of any comparable development in Europe, Monte Rei Golf & Country Club offers a choice of stunning property styles. To experience the lifestyle at Monte Rei, a choice of beautiful villas are available for short term rentals, making the ideal accommodation for families, small business groups or friends who want to enjoy a world-class resort in a unique Algarvean setting.

Company description: Lazy Breakfast Club, all day breakfast & brunch at Porto, Portugal.

Name: Eurotel Altura | Golf & Beach Resort
Company description: Eurotel Altura is located on the lovely Altura beach, in the East Algarve. All rooms have a private balcony and boost spectacular views of the sea. Buffet breakfast is included and there is free parking in the hotel. The hotel has a heated outdoor pool, garden area, tennis court, mini-golf, restaurant, snack bar and bar. The recently built Wellness Center has a hydrotherapy area with Turkish bath, Caribbean Shower and relaxation area. It also has massage and treatment rooms as well as a fully equipped gymnasium. Eurotel Altura also has available a special area for the younger guests, offering a Kids Club with a full entertainment programme all year round. The hotel is located only 10 minutes from 6 golf courses and Faro International Airport is only 40 minutes away

Name: Grupo CCRA
Company description: Grupo empresarial dedicado a investimentos nas áreas de imobiliário, exploração de serviços de restauração, eventos e entretenimento (Restaurantes Ministerium Cantina; La Putana; Marisqueira Azul; Hotdog Lovers; Festivais Lisboa Eletrónica e LISB-ON; Ministerium Club e Ministerium Eventos).

Name: Pine Cliffs Resort
Company description: Pine Cliffs, a Luxury Collection Resort is truly an exquisite hidden jewel enjoying a spectacular, prime seafront location on the amazing coastline of the Algarve, in Southern Portugal. There are several leisure and lifestyle activities for the whole family, with an exclusive 9-hole Golf Course & Golf Academy, Tennis Academy, Serenity SPA, ACTIVE Studio & Health Club, Kids Club, Beach Club, 8 swimming pools and 12 different Restaurants & Bars. Pine Cliffs Resort is an all integrated resort with different options of accommodation, investment opportunities and a luxurious lifestyle for the whole family.  For more information, please visit our website: www.pinecliffs.com,

Name: Caffè Bonini Portugal
Company description: A Caffè Bonini é uma marca italiana de cápsulas de café que possuí uma ampla linha de produtos direcionada para diferentes preferências. É detentora de um sistema de cápsulas próprio, o Bonini Club,  e oferece ainda uma vasta abrangência em compatibilidade para outros sistemas de café.  Focando-se na convicção de que uma pausa só é perfeita com uma bebida do mesmo nível, alia a arte da transformação do café, ao sabor e à experiência italiana.

Name: Jupiter Albufeira Hotel - Family & Fun
Company description: Bem-vindo ao Jupiter Albufeira Hotel - Family & Fun Com diversas áreas de lazer e diversão, difícil será escolher qual o grande destaque do novo Family Resort: Jupiter Albufeira Hotel – Family & Fun, a escolha certa para famílias que apreciam acima de tudo diversão durante as suas férias. Localizado em Albufeira, este novo resort conta com um Kids Club para crianças entre os 4 e os 12 anos e um salão de jogos para os mais crescidos. Mas a diversão não fica por aqui, piscinas, escorregas, parque aquático infantil e ainda um plano de atividades para miúdos e graúdos. Estar de férias também significa relaxar e se há coisa que podemos garantir, é que a partir do momento que entrar no Soul SPA, vai ser impossível não se deixar contagiar pela ambiência e energias que gravitam um pouco por toda a parte.

Name: Verride Palácio De Santa Catarina
Company description: Verride Palácio De Santa Catarina is a luxurious hospitality establishment that combines historical elegance with modern culinary experiences. Located in a beautifully renovated 18th-century palace, the company is dedicated to providing guests with exceptional gastronomic experiences through its renowned restaurant, SUBA, which has been featured in the Michelin Guide since 2022. The Lisbon Club 55, another dining venue within the palace, offers a unique fusion of flavors in a beautifully decorated setting, catering to a diverse clientele. The company’s mission is to ensure that every visitor feels like the protagonist of their culinary journey, emphasizing quality and personalized service. Additionally, the exclusive rooftop bar provides breathtaking 360-degree views of Lisbon and the River Tejo, making it an ideal spot for relaxation and enjoyment. With a focus on creating memorable moments, Verride Palácio De Santa Catarina aims to be a premier destination for both locals and tourists seeking an extraordinary dining and hospitality experience.

Name: Fado&Food Group
Company description: Fado&Food Group: Your Lisbon Experience Immerse yourself in the heart of Lisbon with Fado&Food Group. We are the guardians of Portugal's soul, offering an unforgettable journey through music, culture, and gastronomy. Our iconic establishments, Adega Machado, Café Luso, and Clube de Fado, are more than just restaurants; they are living testaments to Lisbon's rich heritage. Each venue offers a unique ambiance, where the soulful melodies of fado intertwine with the flavors of traditional Portuguese cuisine. At the heart of our philosophy lies a deep respect for tradition. We meticulously source fresh, local ingredients to craft authentic dishes that capture the essence of Portuguese gastronomy. Our talented chefs bring these flavors to life, creating culinary masterpieces that delight the palate. Beyond the exquisite food, our venues are renowned for their world-class fado performances. Talented artists grace our stages, sharing their passion for this soulful music with audiences from around the globe. Whether you're a fado aficionado, a food lover, or simply seeking an authentic Lisbon experience, Fado&Food Group welcomes you to join us on this extraordinary journey. Discover the magic of Portugal one bite, one song at a time.

Name: Castro Marim Golfe & Country Club
Company description: Castro Marim Golfe and Country Club is a luxurious, spacious golf resort (224 hectares) and beautifully situated in the southernmost province of Portugal, the Algarve. The resort has 53 beautifully decorated, large semi-detached villas, each with a breathtaking view on the golf course, the Atlantic Ocean and/or the Guadiana river linking Spain to Portugal. Just a few miles away is Castro Marim’s Beach Restaurant, where you can enjoy one of the finest and widest sandy beaches in Europe. Castro Marim offers a fantastic 27-hole golf course designed by English golf architect Terry Murray. According to the book "1001 Golf holes you must play before you die" written by Jeff Barr, Castro Marim belongs to one of the world's best golf courses. "The hole that must be played" is the 4th hole of the Guadiana Course - a challenging par 5 hole. The golf course has wonderful, elevated greens, sloping fairways, dramatic elevation, undulating greens and several water features and is a challenge for both the novice and the experienced golfer. Castro Marim Golfe and Country Club offers luxurious villas with private pool, three bedrooms and three bathrooms en suite. The villas are extremely spacious and comfortably furnished (220 m²). On the ground floor there is a modern lounge with dining and sitting area, fireplace, TV (cable), DVD player and stereo. The kitchen is very well equipped and has a dishwasher, oven and microwave. In the pantry you will find a washer and dryer. On the ground floor are two double bedrooms with private bathrooms (bath and shower). On the first floor is the third bedroom with balcony and large bathroom with jacuzzi and shower. All villas have a private swimming pool and a large sun terrace with garden furniture, BBQ, sun chairs and a parasol.

Name: Clube Lisboeta
HQ Location: Portugal, Lisbon, Lisbon, 90 Rua Da Escola Politécnica, 1200
Company description: O Clube Lisboeta é um espaço recente no Príncipe Real que oferece a todos os que o visitam, uma inigualável experiência gastronómica à volta do Mundo.  Todos os dias, das 9h às 17h, a viagem faz-se pelo nosso brunch...um vasta oferta de panquecas, tostas, sumos naturais, entre muitas outras! Ao almoço, temos sempre os nossos menus executivos.  E para finalizar o dia, a nossa carta, assinada e executada pela Chef Karin, que o leva a viajar pelos sabores naturais de Portugal, Brasil, Índia e Noruega.  Uma verdadeira explosão de sabores e sempre assente numa das premissas da sociedade dos dias de hoje: uma vida saudável.

Name: Go A Lisboa
Company description: We invite you to step into our Rooftop Oasis & The Supper Club experiences in the heart of Lisbon. Here is where we create joy and magic with every moment. Even during the winter our Lisbon's largest rooftop is covered with windproof/rainproof glasswalls and warm with infrared heaters 25º at night. For an indoor experience, try out our Supper Club restaurant & bar to enjoy drinks, multiple courses a la carte and perhaps some music and/or other entertainment. From serving our delicious and vibrant brunch for breakfast and lunch. Go A Lisboa creations inspired by Inga’s culinary background and passion for storytelling through food. To our lunch and dinner menu that is inspired by the legacy of Goan cuisine fused with modern Portuguese & International flavours and for all dietary preferences: meat, fish, veggie, and vegan. Taste our unique flavour bombs. Our creative mixologist, have produced a playfull yet refined menu of cocktails. Further we offer a wide Portuguese and International selection of beers, cocktails, spirits, wines, mocktails, kombuchas, sydra and naturals. Come for a quick beat or stay for a long while: we’ll welcome you here just the same. Go A Lisboa is the playground that you make out of it!

Name: The Wine Box Porto
HQ Location: Portugal, Porto, Porto, 72 Rua Dos Mercadores, 4050-374
Company description: Situado na rua dos Mercadores, na Ribeira do Porto, uma das zonas mais badaladas da Invicta, fica o The Wine Box Porto. O seu interior é marcado pelo preto das ardósias e pelas madeiras das caixas vínicas que forram as paredes, proporcionando um ambiente acolhedor e descontraído. A carta é muito variada e apelativa, composta por mais de 450 tipos de vinhos das mais diversas Regiões Portuguesas. O The Wine Box Porto destaca-se ainda pela quantidade de vinhos que serve a copo. Qualquer cliente pode desfrutar da enorme variedade de vinhos servidos a copo devido ao inovador sistema do “CORAVIN”.  Tapas e petiscos são as especialidades. O The Wine Box Porto dispõe também de Loja Online (TWB Wine Club). O Clube de vinhos nasceu no coração da cidade Invicta, mais concretamente no restaurante The Wine Box Porto, onde o grande foco é o Vinho e as Tapas.  Com o crescimento do nosso conceito, os nossos clientes sentiram a necessidade de manter contacto com os nossos Sommeliers e criar uma relação de futuro. Aqui nasce o TWB Wine Club. Além da venda online das mais de 450 variadas qualidades de vinhos, dispomos de Sommeliers qualificados ao mais alto nível que proporcionarão ao cliente uma experiência inesquecível.

Name: Barcarola Restaurantes
Company description: Fundado em 1974, o Barcarola com localização na Rua Costa Cabral, rapidamente granjeou um elevado reconhecimento na cidade do Porto. Após um período caracterizado pela perda de algum do vigor existente aquando do seu lançamento, foi adquirido em 1993 por uma equipa com vasta experiência em mercados de outros países, onde durante anos desenvolveram a sua actividade junto de comunidades de raiz portuguesa, imprimindo uma nova dinâmica na sua gestão, e lançando um novo conceito de restauração. O conceito Barcarola alicerça-se, em torno de um projecto de restauração que integra os valores da cozinha tradicional portuguesa, aliados às necessidades de uma alimentação de características marcadamente urbanas, dirigida a clientes que privilegiam a qualidade dos produtos, com um serviço atento e rápido, em espaços confortáveis e familiares, capazes de proporcionar ambientes de convívio e despreocupação. Reconhecido pela qualidade das sua propostas gastronómicas e do seu serviço, o Barcarola rapidamente ascendeu a um lugar de destaque no panorama dos cafés da cidade, assumindo-se como uma “Catedral das Francesinhas” e contribuindo de forma acentuada, para o prestígio daquele que é um Ex-Libris da Gastronomia “tripeira”. Gerador de um “clube de fãs incondicional” a Francesinha do Barcarola é o fruto de um trabalho de rigor que foi ao longo dos anos criando o “segredo” que faz das suas Francesinhas um verdadeiro “mito” causador de romarias tão celebradas pelos seus clientes. Seja para a visita semanal da “Francesinha em família” seja para o grupo de amigos, que em volta de uma mesa de “Francesinhas e finos”, celebram mais uma vitória do clube do seu coração. Hoje, o Barcarola conta também com espaços no Centro Comercial Arrábida Shopping, aberto em 1996 e no Centro Comercial Dolce Vita, aberto em 2005.

Name: Club Des Châteaux Lisbon
HQ Location: Portugal, Lisbon, Lisbon, 43 Rua Actor Taborda, 1000-007
Company description: Club des Châteaux wineries produce limited edition wines, from vines carefully worked in the best terroirs of their regions. These wineries, also known as châteaux (castles, in the literal translation) are, in fact, independant family estates, with centuries of history and long wine tradition in the most famous areas of France (Champagne, Bordeaux, Burgundy,...) and Douro in Portugal. Most have real castles dating from the 11th to the 19th centuries, beautiful and romantic places with the possibility of visits and accommodation. Wine Bar and Wine Shop, next to Saldanha, in the living heart of Lisbon.

Name: Dunas Douradas Beach Club
Company description: Dunas Douradas Beach Club is an award-winning five star resort in the heart of the Algarve’s Golden Triangle. Situated in a privileged setting away from the crowds, overlooking the ocean and endless golden beaches of the Atlantic coastline, our luxury resort welcomes guests to a relaxed and elegant atmosphere. Dunas Douradas Beach Club features an array of facilities and amenities to ensure a memorable relaxing stay and provide a feeling of exclusivity and privacy for our guests.

Name: The Natural Meat Co.
Company description: The The Natural Meat Co. is located in the Algarve in southern Portugal and the principal is to offer the best in certified meat, with a specialised and personalised service. All the selected meat for consumption, it is of Uruguayan origin, exclusively selected by our team, fueled only by natural pastures without antibiotics or hormones. All parts come from animals that have no more than two years, with a weight of 500-600 kg, 30 days in vacuum maturity at temperatures between 0-1 degrees. The Natural Meat Co. customers can still enjoy a tasting area, inside the store, so you can taste the products with an unmatched flavour and preparation, in the style of Uruguay. our mission, aims mainly to provide our clients a unique service with unique products and natural quality, prepared and managed by an experienced and highly qualified staff, thus bringing more quality and flavour to your life. ANIMAL WELFARE This is an issue that is installed in a universal way, through a consumer demand for products of animal origin especially meat. Currently, the Animal Welfare is the focus of numerous workshops, audits and training at all levels. This strategy has generated not only a high promotion of the country associated with this issue, as has Uruguay a world reference on animal welfare in the meat sector. Our beef is produced peel BPU. Ownership of the BPU, lies in "Villas Boas", which is located in Durazno region, on the road number 5, 10 km from the city of Durazno. The Producers' Club aims to ensure the supply of cattle certified with excellent quality for the most demanding markets. For this, the BPU production department has a large team of qualified professionals committed to facilitating the production of this type of financing the producer, certifying that each institution interested in joining the club in the PAC protocol "fields assurance program", developed by the BPU, complies with the requirements of major European markets.

Name: Grupo Romando
HQ Location: Portugal, Porto, Vila Do Conde, 221 Rua Da Fonte, 4480
Company description: O Grupo Romando é hoje uma referência na área da restauração em Portugal. Os contínuos investimentos têm sido uma aposta certeira e de futuro, como são os casos do Romando Sushi Caffè, Romando Privé, Romando Beach Club e, mais recentemente o Romando X Enoteca 17.56 em parceria com a Real Companhia Velha.  Os prémios alcançados nos diferentes projectos são prova do compromisso de qualidade e diferenciação que o Grupo tem apostado ao longo dos anos, sustentado na valorização do capital e relação humana. A nossa missão é aprender continuamente, receber cada vez melhor e proporcionar momentos e experiências únicas.

Name: GOLF SPOT RESTAURANTE - ACADEMIA DE GOLFE DE LISBOA
HQ Location: Portugal, Lisbon, Lisbon, S/n Azinhaga Das Galhardas, 1600-213
Company description: O Restaurante Golf Spot está inserido no complexo da Academia de Golfe de Lisboa (AGL) que se localiza no recinto do Estádio Universitário de Lisboa. Aberto todos os dias, no Club House pode encontrar um Bar Lounge, 2 salas para refeições e 1 sala privada para eventos na qual pode realizar formações, reuniões, sessões clinicas, contando com o apoio do catering do restaurante em termos de coffee breaks, welcome drink, almoço ou jantar.  No exterior pode contar com uma agradável esplanada na qual pode almoçar ou jantar, ou simplesmente tomar um copo ou um café entre refeições. Aqui pode conjugar a restauração com atividades de golfe pois na Academia de Golfe de Lisboa, para além de espaço de treino com áreas de jogo curto (Putiing Green e Chipping), pode contar com um Campo de Pitch & Putt (9 buracos) e Driving & Top Tracer Range com 40 baias em 2 pisos (1 coberto e iluminado), bem como pode organizar uma acção de team building para os colaboradores da sua empresa com uma Clínica de Golfe. Com as duas vertentes, formativa  e lazer, aqui se potencia o convívio social, familiar e empresarial num espaço informal, descontraído, trendy, com uma oferta diversificada, no centro de Lisboa e com a facilidade do parque de estacionamento privativo para cerca de 90 viaturas e carregamentos rápidos para veículos elétricos.

Name: Balance Club
Company description: Balance Club is a Premium Club Network that integrates different services, promoting moments full of health and well-being for the daily lives of its customers.

Name: Sublime Hotels
Company description: SUBLIME COMPORTA Inserido numa incrível propriedade de 17 hectares, rodeado por pinheiros e sobreiros, dunas selvagens, arrozais deslumbrantes e mais de 60 km de praias de areia branca está o Sublime Comporta, um lugar mágico e intocado. SUBLIME COMPORTA BEACH CLUB Em linha com o seu espírito de inovação contínua, o Sublime Comporta decidiu abrir seu próprio restaurante de praia.  A apenas 10 minutos do hotel, está localizado numa das linhas costeiras mais bonitas da Europa e numa das praias mais impressionantes da região - a praia do Carvalhal. SUBLIME LISBOA Situado no coração do bairro das Amoreiras junto a uma das artérias mais privilegiadas de Lisboa, rodeada de edifícios históricos, jardins encantadores, museus, monumentos históricos e um Aqueduto, um elegante palacete do século XX transformado num luxuoso hotel de charme de 15 quartos, abre as suas portas como Sublime Lisboa. DAVVERO A qualidade dos produtos artesanais escolhidos a dedo, os ingredientes frescos e a simplicidade da sua transformação definem o tom do nosso Restaurante Davvero. Do tradicional Aperitivo ao delicioso tiramisu, o chef Isaac Kumi, sobre a visão do Chef Executivo do Grupo Hélio Gonçalves, pretende trazer a Lisboa uma nova experiência num ambiente cosmopolita que promete fazer deste restaurante o próximo hotspot de Lisboa! Pare, respire e aproveite a nossa esplanada. 24 lugares num ambiente confortável no coração de Lisboa.

Name: Well Vale Do Lobo
HQ Location: Portugal, Faro, Loulé, Praça Vale Do Lobo, 8135-034

Ideal for any occasion and group size this stylish venue overlooking the Vale do Lobo beach is the place to be this summer.

Company description: The Marina Club Lagos Resort allies comfort and quietness in an elegant and relaxed space that will make your experience unique and unforgettable. Welcome aboard!

Name: Thai Beach Club

Name: Lisbon Sports Club
Company description: The Lisbon Sports Club (LSC), founded in 1861, has its origins in the Lisbon Cricket Club, which started within the British community resident in the region of Lisbon and mostly linked to the Railway Industry. The construction, ten years later, of the bullfighting ring in Campo Pequeno (where LSC had been created), led to its first change of place and the abandonment of Lisbon.  Its next home was a property in Algés, where for the first time it boasted a 6-hole golf course.  This was however a temporary solution, and in 1914 LSC was transferred to the Eastern Telegraph Company property in Carcavelos.  This is where the Lisbon Golf Cup was created (it is still contested today).  LSC itself was only officially founded in 1922, when it acquired a land in Alto da Ajuda and 9 holes with greens made of sand mixed with oil. When in the early 1960's, the Lisbon City Council began a process of expropriation of land in the Alto da Ajuda, the Club was forced to seek a new place to settle, and moved to the Casal da Carregueira in Belas, opening its first 9 holes in 1964. Later on five more holes were added and LSC survived for many years with only 14 holes (to complete 18, holes numbers 2,3,4 and 5 were played once again – not a successful solution).  In 1992 the last four holes were finally opened.

With direct access to the beach and in full harmony with nature, the resort has several support infrastructures and a wide range of services and amenities in line with a healthy, holistic lifestyle, where nature takes center stage. Here everything is full. Of senses. Of experiences. Of well-being.  Already this summer, the Verdelago Resort will have, besides the approximately 50 tourist-residential units available for rent, a Wellness Dome, a complex with several multi-sports fields (2 tennis, 4 paddle tennis, 1 soccer, 1 sand court for volleyball, and beach soccer), a BMX/BTB pumptrack, several walking and cycling paths of about 7 km among cork and pine trees, temporary ponds and a lagoon, family support services (Kids Club and babysitting), a swimming pool in the central area of the resort. In the future, it will also have an orchard and vegetable garden with local products and a riding arena with horses for rides inside the resort. Verdelago Resort is also the first tourist resort in the country to join the Green Globe certification, one of the most demanding international sustainable tourism certifications, with affiliation to the United Nations Tourism Organization. In the cruise year, it will have 340 tourist residential units and a 197-room five-star hotel. Find out how to book your stay or purchase one of the magnificent properties at www.verdelago.com

Name: SDivine Fátima Hotel
HQ Location: Portugal, Santarém, Fátima, 101 Rotunda Dos Peregrinos, 2495-412
Company description: SDivine Fátima Hotel is situated in one of the main entrances of Fatima in a majestic building dated from 1954, at the time with the purpose of forming the new Missionaries of the Divine Word. Later it was transformed into a 2 star Hotel and very recently at the beginning of the 2nd half of 2019 reopened completely renovated and endowed with the best conditions for a 4 star Hotel. Ideal for rest, for a family weekend, business meetings, conferences, training or even a spiritual retreat, this is a Hotel whose building is a reference in Fatima, for the long history and the feeling of tranquillity and inner peace that transmits to its guests. The Hotel's Private Chapel is a place of worship where everyone is welcome and where it is also possible to celebrate private events. The hotel has a gymnasium, kids club (these 2 spaces are not yet completed), children's playground, restaurant, bar, banquet space and auditorium with capacity for up to 240 people, as well as multiple meeting rooms that can be adapted to various formats events and a spacious car park. Also worthy of mention are the large and emblematic gardens that surround the SDivine Fátima Hotel and allow all those who visit us to practice outdoor activities, meditation or even a relaxed meal in the shade of the many species of centenary trees present in our gardens. Located just 2 minutes from the A1 motorway exit and 1km from the Sanctuary of Our Lady of the Rosary of Fátima, a few kilometres away you will find many other sites worth visiting such as the Monastery of Batalha, the Convent of Christ in Tomar, Nazaré beach, the medieval town of Óbidos, the university city of Coimbra, etc.

Emails que circulam diariamente: mais de 166 mil... Emails que circulam mensalmente: mais de 5 milhões... Emails que circulam no espaço de um ano: quase 60 milhões... Junte-se a nós em: www.rede-t.com!

Name: Micampus Residencias
Company description: Micampus Residencias is a leading provider of student accommodation in Spain and Portugal, offering a range of modern and comfortable living spaces tailored for university students. With a mission to create a supportive and enriching environment, Micampus aims to enhance the academic and personal development of its residents by providing not just housing, but a vibrant community where students can thrive. The company operates multiple residences in key cities, including Málaga, Valencia, and Madrid, strategically located near major universities to facilitate easy access for students. Micampus also offers a variety of amenities and services, such as communal areas, fitness facilities, and educational support through its Micampus Club, which provides additional resources like medical consultations and language classes. Targeting university students from diverse backgrounds, Micampus partners with educational institutions to ensure a seamless transition into student life, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a balanced and fulfilling university experience.

Name: The Ivens Hotel

Name: Agua Hotels Vale Da Lapa
Company description: Welcome to the newest and most exciting 5 star resort in the Algarve.    Água Hotels Vale da Lapa is a luxury 5 star resort located no more than 40 minutes from Faro International Airport between the two fishing villages of Carvoeiro and Ferragudo. The resort offers 85 tastefully appointed deluxe Suites and Villas for two, four or six persons surrounded by lush gardens, lakes and creeks carefully designed to create a truly relaxing environment. At short distance you may enjoy two of the most beautiful beaches the Algarve has to offer, Caneiros and Carvoeiro. At the resort you may enjoy the exclusive clubhouse with it’s surprising restaurant, bar with al fresco terrace and outdoor poll as well as the luxurious Spa with health and beauty treatments. For those looking for active holidays the resort also boasts excellent sporting facilities such as an outdoor running track, two paddle tennis courts, a 9 hole putting green, multi-use Astroturf area, and for the little ones, a dedicated play area and children’s pool. In the resort vicinity you may also find several golf courses, a horse-riding center, a tennis club and several other activities to fill your holidays with truly unforgettable moments.
